bio.text: Brad Lander, then New York City Comptroller, announced in December 2025 that he would run for Congress against Rep. Dan Goldman.

According to Ballotpedia, Lander defeated Goldman in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for New York's 10th Congressional District, 66.0% to 33.8%, and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate in November.
He was New York City Comptroller from January 1, 2022, to January 1, 2026, and before that represented City Council District 39 from 2010 to 2021.

Ballotpedia says he graduated from the University of Chicago, holds master's degrees from University College London and the Pratt Institute, and directed the Pratt Center for Community Development and the Fifth Avenue Committee.
